hina (pm): FYI: Competitor Q launched a "pay-per-index" embedding tier overnight. customers pinging for a budget index path. want to sketch options in this thread. :wave:
maria: thanks. initial ask from sales: can we ship a low-cost embedding tier with quick timelines? not asking for parity, just a demonstrably cheaper path for cold/archival indexes.
oliver (eng): technical reality: to reach their price we likely need 8-bit quant + separate serving pool and new routing rules. risk is quality drift on edge cases. rough estimate 4-6 weeks for a hardened canary.
sam (data): i can run a targeted evaluation across our enterprise corpora. measure precision@10, recall@100, and a CTR proxy. will include adversarial shard. need permission to use trial corpora.
taylor: product options (pick one): 1) Match price with "Embed-Budget" (non-SLA, hosted-only). 2) Keep premium lane but add clearer quality analytics for customers. 3) Hybrid: limited budget tier with auto-fallback + strict canary. pros/cons?
dina (sales): quick wins with option 1. Customers want simple pricing. enterprise will request exclusions (Dedicated/Private) — fine to block. sales would prefer a single price test cohort to validate conversion.
maria: proposal: we pursue a scoped hybrid (option 3) but lock launch gates: - quality gap <= 2.5% precision@10 - 95th latency <= 150ms - unit cost <= $0.0007 per 768-d - per-tenant auto-rollback if retrieval_success drops >5% for 30m - hosted-only, non-SLA for initial GA
oliver (eng): agree but add infra constraints: separate autoscaler, image with quant kernels, cache policy updates. need 2 canary nodes. also tokenization accounting differs; include token-cost metrics.
sam (data): I'll deliver bench results + adversarial shard by EOD Thu. will also simulate business impact (CTR proxy).
maria: rollout/canary plan sketch: 0-48h: 1% traffic monitor signals; 48-96h: 10% if stable; 96-168h: 25% then GA. auto-fallback per tenant on threshold.
taylor: GTM: hosted-only message, emphasize "cost for cold indexes" and clearly call out non-SLA. pricing experiment: $0.00065 / 768-d for first 100M tokens for trial cohort.
dina (sales): i'll run price tests with three trial customers and report acceptable thresholds.
oliver (eng): engineering owners: infra spike this sprint, then perf tuning sprint next. timeline to canary ~6 weeks. we'll prepare a flaggable route policy for per-tenant rollback.
maria: owners & deadlines: sam -> bench & adversarial by Thu EOD; oliver -> infra spike plan by Tue; taylor -> pricing + one-pager for sales by Mon; dina -> customer thresholds by Mon. sync Fri 9am for final go/no-go.
deploy-bot: canary GPU request submitted (2x gpus) pending approval.
hina (pm): thanks. lean into the hybrid so we can validate conversion while protecting product experience. if anyone finds competitor configs or labs, paste here. :mag:
